item.title: Add git merge --abort on squash merge failure
item.intent: A failed squash merge must not leave the repo in a dirty merge state — the orchestrator must abort the merge cleanly so the next sprint can start fresh.
steps: Locate the git merge --squash failure path (~line 2957-2979 in .aishore/aishore)
Add git merge --abort 2>/dev/null before setting AISHORE_FEATURE_BRANCH empty
Add a log_warning if merge --abort itself fails
Verify the cleanup path still deletes the feature branch correctly

acceptanceCriteria.text: git merge --abort is called when squash merge fails
Feature branch cleanup still works after abort
